name: engram
description: Local-only temporal memory for Claude Code sessions. Adds an MCP server, ten /engram: slash commands, and SessionStart, SubagentStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, PreToolUse, and file-touched hooks backed by a single-binary, append-only SQLite store at ~/.engram — no account, and nothing that leaves your machine: the server listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Facts are never mutated or deleted, only superseded, with the reason for every revision recorded.

lens_auto_open.title: Open the memory lens automatically
lens_auto_open.description: Open the memory lens pane the first time the model recalls from Engram in a session, instead of waiting for the lens command.

status_entry.title: Show memory status in the status line
status_entry.description: Add an Engram entry (embedding backlog and server state) to the status line.

toasts_enabled.title: Toast when Engram captures a fact
toasts_enabled.description: Show a short notice when a fact stated in a prompt is stored.

chime.title: Chime on memory activity
chime.description: Play a sound on memory activity. captures: when a fact stated in a prompt is stored; this needs 'Toast when Engram captures a fact' on, and does nothing while it is off. recalls: when the model makes a new recall that comes back with high coverage, not on every recall. both: either.

jit_mode.title: Just-in-time primer mode
jit_mode.description: off does nothing. shadow runs the same recall for each typed prompt of 12 or more characters (not a slash command) and leaves a record in the server's telemetry, without adding anything to the prompt. inject adds the recalled digest to the prompt as context, only when its coverage is high.

jit_budget_tokens.title: Just-in-time primer budget (tokens)
jit_budget_tokens.description: Token budget for the per-prompt recall the just-in-time primer runs: a whole number from 50 to 4000; anything else uses 400.

sentinel_mode.title: Invariant sentinel mode
sentinel_mode.description: What happens the first time an edit touches a file that has invariant facts (once per file per session): off does nothing; inform attaches the invariants to the edit for the model and shows a notice; deny-once refuses that first attempt with the invariants, so the model re-issues it.

belief_diff_scope.title: Belief diff scope
belief_diff_scope.description: Which revisions the model proposes through engram_revise are put to you for approval (Approve or Keep old) before they apply: off asks about none; personal asks only about your own statements, directives and invariants; all asks about every revision.

digest_every_n_turns.title: Automatic digest interval (turns)
digest_every_n_turns.description: Run a memory digest after every N completed turns of the main conversation, or sooner (from the second turn on) after a turn that edited files; 0 disables it.

tail_auto_open.title: Open the memory tail automatically
tail_auto_open.description: Open the live memory tail pane when you send the first prompt of a session (including after /clear), instead of waiting for the tail command.

tail_scope.title: Memory tail scope
tail_scope.description: session shows this session's writes, retractions and activity, including its own Engram calls; all shows everything from every session, the command line and the server.

digest_auto_save.title: Save digest memories without review
digest_auto_save.description: Save what the automatic digest proposes straight away and show it in a toast, instead of waiting for you to tick and press Save. Saved facts are marked as unreviewed.
